items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: So I went up to the stand and said, Sidney, where's your saxophone? He said, it's in pawn.

ctx.x: Well, I had a... This particular night, I went up to the deluxe where Sidney Baixier was playing, and he's got one of these B-flat curved modern saxophone sopranos. Yes. Playing the hell out of him, no kidding. And I went back raving that next night on the job, so I got Buster Clippet King, and my fibbers come up there to hear him play the saxophone, and he don't pick it up to him. So I went up to the stand and said, Sidney, where's your saxophone? He said, it's in pawn. I said, oh, man. I said, look, you guys up…
He said, that's all right. Yeah, that's no kidding.
